scope: Independent read-only code/design and saved raw evidence review. No workload, benchmark, test execution, source/test/dependency edits or commits.

report.method: Two real state locks held simultaneously, barrier then each retrieves its already-loaded own goal. Unchanged10-second lock timeout; no mocked locks or workload retries. Fixture owned outside checkout, default persistence format.

accepted_design: Lazy cached-first iteration returns an already-loaded target before unrelated capsule state locks; cached iteration order is retained from the previous implementation.

Scoped getters load the canonical owning capsule through unchanged load_capsule recovery, state lock, model validation, run identity and cached generation behavior. They catch only NotFoundError; conflicts/corruption are not suppressed.
Scoped misses and foreign entity IDs return None with no global fallback. Unscoped generic discovery remains available for callers that actually lack an owner.
Snapshot takes the same owning run lock and reads all rows and events within its UoW; scoped goal/evidence reads do not weaken its event cursor coherence.
Approval creation, stale-subject rejection, exact delivery binding, persisted decisions and idempotency are retained. All production approval get callers now pass their known run.

Run list comprehensions and auxiliary _find still exhaust discovery; auxiliary global duplicate detection is not short-circuited. Cached-first goal/evidence/approval getters already used first-match semantics before this fix.
Existing added tests use actual opposing locks, cover cached unscoped hits, scoped missing/foreign IDs, missing owner, cold cross-run generic discovery and full run list.
All 27 production goal/evidence lookup calls carry run_id in the final reviewed source, including all five previously unscoped evidence reads.
Plan-derived run_id scopes are consistent: orchestrator, revision and replanning first lock plan.run_id and validate the current goal before retrieving that goal.
Evidence reviewer run/criterion/status checks remain intact after scoping; missing and foreign IDs now resolve to None in the owning capsule before authorization rejection.

historical_remaining_findings.issue: GoalService.validate holds its run state lock and calls unscoped get_evidence for a new uuid5 ID. The normal first validation misses its cached own aggregate and exhausts unrelated capsule loads, permitting the same opposing-run lock inversion.
historical_remaining_findings.minimal_action: Pass run_id=run_id to this get_evidence call; verify the real service first-validation path avoids foreign state reads while its own lock is held.

historical_remaining_findings.issue: Caller-supplied missing or foreign evidence IDs are looked up under a known locked run before authorization rejection; unscoped misses can acquire unrelated run locks.
historical_remaining_findings.minimal_action: Pass the known run_id or run.id; keep current unrelated/stale/criterion validation checks.

historical_remaining_findings.issue: Persisted evidence references under known runs normally hit cache but a stale/malformed reference triggers global discovery.
historical_remaining_findings.minimal_action: Scope both remaining evidence callers. Scope internal known-run get_goal callers consistently to avoid missing/foreign goal fallback.

scoped_lookup_closure_limits: No remaining unscoped production goal/evidence caller found. This does not qualify arbitrary multi-run UoWs, global duplicate scans, or unscoped generic consumers as deadlock-free.
